notes.title: Vacant's Mine - Official Gameplay Reveal
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cxFlLv8sHoc;full][/previewyoutube]
So you’ve been arrested? No Problem! In Vacant’s Mine you can regain your freedom in just 7 Days! With a Mine Railway and a Plunger you’ll navigate through an abandoned mine to steal eggs. But beware of the Greebs, they have terrifying big mouths and razor sharp teeth!
[h3]
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wVkCSStS8f7og9CUrX2ACG3I28xiqjS4?usp=sharing]PRESS KIT[/url][/h3]

[h2]When will the game come out?[/h2]
Vacant's Mine opens on March 29th. 

[h2]How long is the game?[/h2]
It takes around 2 hours to regain your freedom in Vacant's Mine.

[h2]Is there an admission fee to enter Vacant's Mine? [/h2]
The admission fee to enter Vacant's Mine, which gives you the chance to regain your freedom, is approximately $5 USD. 

[h2]Is there a storyline?[/h2]
The lore is explained through Video sequences, audio, video and text logs. 
However, the log part isn't necessary to complete the game.

[h2]Should I add Vacant's Mine to my Wishlist?[/h2]
Yes, add Vacant's Mine to your Wishlist to get notified as soon it opens.
